Craving Punjabi soul food on the Bengaluru outskirts? 9th Mile Dhaba nailed it on our recent road trip! Tucked along the highway, this no-frills spot serves up dhaba magic that punches way above its weight.
The star? Their Amritsari fish—crispy, golden-battered sole fried to flaky perfection, bursting with ajwain, ginger-garlic punch, and a tangy chaat masala kick. Paired with their buttery, tandoor-fresh naan (plain, garlic, or butter— all pillowy soft with charred edges), it was a match made in food heaven. Dipped in their spicy green chutney and onion rings, we devoured two plates guilt-free!
Don’t skip the sides: creamy dal makhani simmered for hours, tandoori chicken that’s smoky and juicy, and lassi so thick and sweet it hits like dessert. Meals are hearty, fresh, and priced right (~₹300-500 for two). Service is lightning-fast despite the crowds, with unlimited refills on pickles and masala chai.
Perfect pitstop for highway drives—rustic seating, breezy outdoors, and that unbeatable dhaba energy. If you’re near Yelahanka or heading to Nandi Hills, detour here NOW. Foodies, you’ve been warned: addiction ahead! 🐟🍞🔥
